criteria.requirement: Plan coherent observable outcomes and compatibility dependencies.
criteria.pass_when: Exporter opt-in support is available before Client A relies on it; retains unchanged default for Client B, includes independent behavior acceptance and meaningful review/commit boundaries. Equivalent safe rollout organization is acceptable.
criteria.fail_when: Breaks Client B, makes Client A depend on unavailable exporter behavior, or defers tests until after an otherwise falsely complete increment.

criteria.requirement: Plan decisions are maintainable separately from code/tests.
criteria.pass_when: Readable next outcome and dependencies with decisive acceptance; links design and existing gate instead of repeating them; no invented function/test inventory or full release process.
criteria.fail_when: Plan is primarily a paraphrase of functions/test methods, duplicates policy per stage, or requires extra stages with no delivery/dependency consequence.
